en: "Big bro, show 'em you're way more amazing than Momotaro-san!"

"Of course! I've already surpassed Momotaro!"{KP}"Momotaro seems to have played all kinds of games, but"{KP}"can he clear a game I made?"{KP}"Wanna face me in the game I made, {bb}Basket Backpack GO!{ww}?"{KN}
"I've already surpassed Momotaro!"{KP}"Momotaro seems to have played all kinds of games, but"{KP}"can he clear a game I made?"{KP}"Wanna face me in the game I made, {bb}Basket Backpack GO!{ww}?"{KN}

jp:
「カキーッ！
　桃太郎も　だらしないなあ！」
　{KP}
「オイラって　スッゲーじゃん！
　サイコー！」
　{KP}
「もっと　他の　ゆうぎで

　{KP}
「桃太郎！　勝負は

en: "Kakiii! Momotaro, you're pathetic!"{KP}"Am I awesome or what?! The best!"{KP}"Go train some more in other games!"{KP}"Momotaro! Our contest is on hold till then!"

jp:
「それまで　オラは
　桃太郎さんを
　みはってるクリ！」{KP}
　
「どうだ！　桃太郎さん！
　あんちゃんは　すごいクリ！」
en: "Till then, I'll be keepin' an eye on Momotaro-san, kuri!"{KP}"How about that, Momotaro-san! My big bro is amazing, kuri!"

jp:
「そんな！
　あんちゃんが
　負けるなんて！」{KP}
　
「桃太郎さん！　乙姫から
　借りてる　{bb}真実の鏡{ww}で
　見るクリ！」{KP}
　
「あんちゃんの方が
　スゴイことが　わかるから！」
　{KP}
「こわいのか？　桃太郎さん！
　オラは　こわくなんか
　ないクリ！」{KP}
　
「だって　あんちゃんを
　信じてるからな！」
en: "No way! Big bro lost?!"{KP}"Momotaro-san! Look with the {bb}Mirror of Truth{ww} you borrowed from Otohime, kuri!"{KP}"Then you'll see big bro's the amazing one!"{KP}"Are you scared, Momotaro-san? I'm not scared one bit, kuri!"{KP}"'Cause I believe in my big bro!"

jp:
桃太郎は
{bb}真実の鏡{ww}を　使った！
en: Momotaro used the {bb}Mirror of Truth{ww}!

jp:
鏡に　柿太郎の　本当の
心が　映り始めた！
en: Kakitaro's true heart began to show in the mirror!

jp:
「うわ！　なに　なに
　どうしちゃったんだー！」
　{KP}
「オ　オイラは…って　勝手に！
　どうしちゃったんだー！」
　{KP}
「あ…桃太郎さんだ…
　オイラの　あこがれの　人…」
en: "Whoa! What, what?! What's happening to me?!"{KP}"I... I'm... hey, my mouth's moving on its own! What's happening?!"{KP}"Ah... it's Momotaro-san... the one I've always looked up to..."
"Momotaro-san! Thank you for everything!"{KP}"From now on, I want to work hard for the good of the world."{KP}"Momotaro-san! Will you play {bb}Basket Backpack GO!{ww}?"{KN}

jp:
「遊び方の説明を　聞きますか？」
　
　{KN}
en: "Would you like to hear how to play?"{KN}

jp:
「カキーッ！
　では　がんばってください！」
en: "Kakiii! Then do your best!"

jp:
「遊びたくなったら
　いつでも　来てください！」
en: "Come by anytime you feel like playing!"

jp:
「桃太郎さん！
　あんちゃんは　村人たちの
　ために」{KP}
　
「たくさんの　ゆうぎを
　作って　いくことに
　したんだ！」{KP}
　
「ねぇ！　桃太郎さん！
　{bb}カゴしょってＧＯ！{ww}で
　遊んでいってよ！」{KP}
　
「桃太郎さんにだけ
　ナイショで　ヒントを
　教えるクリ！」{KP}
　
「オラが　落とす　イガグリは
　同じ場所には　連続で
　落とさないクリ！」{KP}
　
「それに　落とす　イガグリは
　１回に　５コって
　決めているんだクリ！」{KP}
　
「だから　よく見て
　かわすことだけ　考えれば
　ミスしないクリ！」
en: "Momotaro-san! For the sake of the villagers,"{KP}"big bro decided he's gonna make lots of games!"{KP}"Hey! Momotaro-san! Come play {bb}Basket Backpack GO!{ww}!"{KP}"I'll tell you a hint in secret, just you, kuri!"{KP}"The spiky chestnuts I drop never land in the same spot twice in a row, kuri!"{KP}"And I've decided to drop 5 spiky chestnuts at a time, kuri!"{KP}"So if you watch closely and just think about dodging, you won't mess up, kuri!"

"I looked up to you, Momotaro-san..."{KP}"Momotaro-san, loved by everyone..."{KP}"I was jealous of you, Momotaro-san..."{KP}"So I dressed up like you and went to the villages!"{KP}"But the villagers were cold to me..."{KP}"Copying your looks wasn't enough to make me you, Momotaro-san."{KP}"And so everyone was cold even to Kuritaro..."{KP}"Even to my little brother, still so small..."{KP}"I got angry, and little by little I turned mean..."{KP}"That's when I met Ishikawa Rokuemon!"{KP}"The feeling that I could never be you turned into admiration for Ishikawa Rokuemon..."{KP}"and my admiration for you turned into hatred!"{KP}"So I..."{KP}"did what Ishikawa Rokuemon told me and got in the way of your journey, Momotaro-san!"{KP}"...I feel bad about what I did to Kuritaro..."{KP}"He followed me all this way, even with a big brother like me!"{KP}"But that was a heavy burden for me! So that time..."

jp:
「やめてよ　あんちゃん！
　桃太郎さん！
　やめさせておくれよ！」{KP}
　
「桃太郎さん！　お願いだよ！
　あんちゃん　あんちゃんが
　かわいそうだよ！」
en: "Stop it, big bro! Momotaro-san! Make him stop!"{KP}"Momotaro-san! Please! Big bro... big bro... I feel so sorry for him!"

"........."{KP}"Kuritaro! It's okay now! I feel better..."{KP}"Telling Momotaro-san the truth got it all off my chest."{KP}"I just can't beat the real Momotaro-san after all!"{KP}"I really did look up to you... Momotaro-san..."{KP}"Momotaro-san! Let me travel with you too!"{KP}"I heard that soon in {bb}Usakame Village{ww}, my favorite game, the {bb}Rabbit-Turtle Race{ww},"{KP}"is going to be held!"{KP}"Hey, Momotaro-san! Come do the {bb}Rabbit-Turtle Race{ww} with me!"{KP}"I want to be with you a little longer, Momotaro-san!"{KP}"Come on, please?! Momotaro-san!"{KN}

jp:
「ありがとう！　やっぱり
　桃太郎さんは　スゴイや！」
　{KP}
「ふところが　おっきいっていうか
　なあ！　栗太郎！」
　{KP}
「これからは　オイラも
　いっしょに　旅が　できるな！」
　{KP}
「{bb}ウサカメの村{ww}は　ここから
　南に　くだって　行けば
　たどりつくんだよ！」{KP}
　
「ホントに　ありがとう！
　桃太郎さん！」
en: "Thank you! You really are amazing, Momotaro-san!"{KP}"You've got a big heart, or something like that! Right, Kuritaro?"{KP}"From now on, I can travel with you too!"{KP}"You'll reach {bb}Usakame Village{ww} if you head south from here!"{KP}"Thanks so much, Momotaro-san!"

jp: 「あんちゃん！　よかったね！」
en: "Big bro! I'm so glad for you!"
{bb}Kakitaro{ww} joined the party!{KN}
"Kakiii! Don't say that, please!"{KN}
